derivedFrom: The FVP adapter template of the installed CMSIS Solution 1.72.1-86-20261109 (templates/debug/FVP.adapter.json: CMSIS Load an echo, CMSIS Run the model as a shell task, CMSIS Load+Run their dependsOn sequence), and the event order VS Code 1.146 fired for a tasks.json of that shape with a stand-in model that prints and exits at once: no start event of the compound, which ends after Run. Times are illustrative milliseconds from the call.
description: cmsis_action load_and_run (FVP template): the model runs a test image that prints its result and requests an EOT shutdown, so the process of CMSIS Run ends with exit 0 inside the 2 s grace (#134). The run completed: the job is ok and decided by Run, not a GDB server that failed to stay up.

loadRun.name: CMSIS Load+Run
loadRun.execution: none: dependsOn [CMSIS Load, CMSIS Run], dependsOrder sequence

execution.commandLine: echo CMSIS Load: images are loaded by the FVP model when CMSIS Run starts.
